text: I think you'll really enjoy this Creamy Oven-Baked Risotto recipe! It features some of your favorite ingredients, including mushrooms and fresh ground pepper, which are staples in many of the recipes you've liked in the past. The addition of cream of mushroom soup and parmesan cheese will give the dish a rich and creamy texture that's sure to please. Plus, it's a relatively quick and easy recipe to make, taking only about 40 minutes to prepare, which fits within the time frame of most of the recipes you've liked.
